name: Nullform Adaptive Stealth Cloak
description:
A floor-length cloak in matte black that does not stay matte black. The outer shell is composed of layered metamaterial panels — flexible photonic cells capable of sampling ambient light and replicating it across the garment's surface with a half-second latency. In motion, the effect is smearing and slightly wrong, a shimmer that the eye slides off rather than focuses on. Standing still in low light, it is genuinely difficult to see. The interior is raw charcoal jersey against the skin, surprisingly soft, with a deep hood lined in the same metamaterial. The weight is considerable — full active operation draws from a slim battery panel sewn into the back yoke, rated for six hours continuous.

Nullform is a Tier 5 label that operates more like a weapons contractor than a fashion house — no retail presence, acquisition by referral only, manufactured in a facility whose location is not public knowledge. Wearing one in open spaces is technically legal but draws immediate attention from corporate security and law enforcement. The people who own these are not wearing them to clubs. They are wearing them to places they are not supposed to be, and they have the resources to be there anyway.
functionality: Active light-bending adaptive camouflage — samples ambient light and replicates it across surface panels. Effective in low light and shadow conditions. Six-hour battery life. Partial effectiveness in motion, near-full effectiveness when stationary.
what_it_says: You exist in spaces where being seen is a choice, not a given.
story_hooks: A Nullform cloak surfaces in a Tier 2 pawnshop — the owner has no idea what it is, priced it at Φ200, and the person who brought it in hasn't been seen since
The metamaterial panels can be individually removed and repurposed — someone has been stripping them from stolen cloaks and selling the cells to a Shelf engineer building something much larger

Nullform has issued a recall notice for serial numbers in a specific range, citing a 'thermal cascade failure risk' — but the people who own those cloaks are not the kind of people who respond to recall notices

physical_description.visual_profile: A floor-length silhouette that seems to absorb and redirect attention. The cloak drapes with deliberate weight, creating defined folds that shift in appearance depending on viewing angle. In motion, the surface ripples with a subtle chromatic distortion—light fragmenting and reassembling with noticeable lag. Stationary in shadow, the wearer becomes nearly invisible, a void with only the hood's outline suggested. The overall impression is predatory and intentional, more weapon than garment.
physical_description.fit: Loose, enveloping drape with a deep hood that obscures facial features entirely. The internal cut is generous enough to conceal augmentation rigs and weapons harnesses. No cinching at waist or hem—it moves as a unified mass, obscuring body shape completely.
physical_description.primary_material: Outer shell: layered metamaterial photonic panels with programmable light-replication. Inner lining: raw charcoal jersey knit, unwashed softness against bare skin.
physical_description.texture: Outer surface shifts visually between matte and shimmering depending on active state and ambient conditions. Touch: the metamaterial is smooth but subtly resilient, cool to contact. Inner jersey is soft, slightly napped, warm. The back yoke where the battery integrates is reinforced and slightly rigid.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary matte black with a half-second-delayed chromatic echo that mirrors surroundings—the effect is desynchronized and slightly nauseating to track. No fixed secondary colors; the shimmer adapts to environment. In deep shadow, appears as pure black void.
physical_description.closures: No visible closures—the cloak wraps and drapes freely, settling naturally. Hood seals via friction-fit against the jersey interior. Battery panel at back yoke is sealed with proprietary magnetic connectors.
distinctive_features: Metamaterial photonic cells capable of real-time ambient light sampling and replication
Integrated slim-profile battery pack in back yoke (6-hour continuous operation)
Deep hood lined in metamaterial, fully obscures wearer's face and augmentation signatures
Noticeable latency in light replication creates 'smearing' effect that eye instinctively avoids
Raw, unsealed charcoal jersey interior suggests industrial purpose over luxury
Considerable weight indicates engineering priority over comfort
No manufacturer branding visible—unmarked except for internal serial beneath hood
Reinforced panels at high-stress points suggest tactical durability
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 black-market/contractor-grade. The price point is not public, acquisition is referral-only. Legal to own but ownership is tracked and flagged.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by people operating outside corporate and governmental oversight—runners, infiltrators, wetwork operatives, high-tier insurgents. The wearer is signaling they have resources, dangerous intent, and acceptance of consequences. It is not aspirational fashion; it is a declaration.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when new, but the metamaterial shows micro-scratches and photonic lag degradation with use. Well-maintained examples retain responsiveness; heavy-use versions have visible panel damage and slower light-replication cycles. Battery efficiency degrades predictably. The inner jersey remains soft regardless of external wear.

image_prompt: Nullform Adaptive Stealth Cloak draped on a dark chrome mannequin in a concrete warehouse interior. The cloak's surface ripples with a nauseating chromatic shimmer—light fragmenting and reassembling with visible latency. Deep hood obscures the mannequin's head entirely, creating an unsettling void. Industrial fluorescent lighting casts hard shadows that the cloak partially replicates, creating desynchronized echoes. In the background, razor-wire fencing and dimly-lit server towers. The overall mood is predatory, technological, morally ambiguous. Neo-noir noir aesthetic. Professional product photography with moody, cold color grading. --ar 2:3 --v 6
